definitions.gloss: to stop, to halt, to turn off
definitions.explanation: Used when stopping or halting something. This is a transitive verb—you stop something.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}を{止|と}めてください。
ここに{車|くるま}を{止|と}めてもいいですか。
examples.english: May I park my car here?

notes: 止める is a transitive verb meaning 'to stop something.' The intransitive pair is 止まる (tomaru, to stop on its own). Also note 泊める (tomeru, to let someone stay) is a different word. Conjugation: 止めない (negative), 止めます (polite), 止めた (past).
